scope: Approved SDK prerequisites and Folders source adoption; whole-story review remains separate

findings.claim: Expired unconditional compaction accepts its own undeleted envelope
findings.evidence: Parent probe b1 returns Completed with its own 221-byte envelope still physically present after every conditional delete is refused. IsCompacted treats IsOmittedExpired as sufficient even after installation; logical reads hide the payload and no TTL removes that envelope.

findings.claim: Completed retained scratch receipt is reclaimed without durable late-installer recovery proof
findings.evidence: Parent independently reran the edge reproduction: helper completes, private row and Completed receipt are reclaimed, Abort opens, then a paused installer persists its envelope and exits before its post-check. The orphan remains and RecoverPendingAsync returns invalid-recovery-evidence. This is a new Completed-retained path, not the fixed legacy-Aborted claim from R3-B1.

findings.claim: Retained Aborted retirement records have no participant proof for a late installer
findings.evidence: Parent b3 stages the retained original with a helper, aborts and reclaims it, then resumes the delayed physical installation and exits before its post-check. The surviving retirement has zero anchors, private bytes remain, and exact recovery returns invalid-recovery-evidence. A retirement decision alone cannot authorize restoration.

findings.claim: Legacy compensation proof shrinks the supported original manifest capacity
findings.evidence: Parent b4 stages a valid two-key legacy scratch batch whose original canonical manifest is 801760 bytes, below the unchanged 1048576 limit. Recovery refuses it as legacy-scratch-evidence-too-large because already base64-encoded envelopes are encoded again into proof under the original manifest byte limit; scratch remains.

findings.claim: Folders manually constructed coordinator ignores the configured deadline clock
findings.evidence: Parent b5 resolves the writer through AddFoldersOperationalStatusPersistence with an injected IUtcClock and a store using the same TimeProvider. Its internal coordinator still uses System. After an abandoned COW replacement and expiry, the correctly configured coordinator returns available absence; the actual writer coordinator throws selected copy-on-write value is missing. This differs from fixed SDK registration R3-B5; parent owns the consumer correction.

findings.claim: In-memory conditional ETag probe disagrees with logical expiry visibility
findings.evidence: Parent b6 completes identical deadline batches and advances exactly to expiry. Both GetAsync values are absent, but fake TryReadEtagAsync returns Present=true while Dapr returns false. The interface requires the probe to mirror store visibility, so coordinated erasure tests take different branches. Reusing the existing shared resolver is a direct internal correction.

findings.claim: Retained fencing metadata lacks operator lifecycle and offboarding guidance
findings.evidence: Terminal fences persist exact scope including tenant identity, and legacy Aborted markers intentionally remain after receipt reclamation; the guide currently describes only original manifests/receipts. OffboardTenantAsync does not enumerate or delete these new fences. A direct guide correction must state this retained-data inventory, safe retention/removal prerequisites and offboarding limitation; no new discovery service or automatic fence TTL is needed.

findings.claim: Installer marker checks unnecessarily apply to all ordinary resumable operations
findings.evidence: Private retirement reads already use MayHavePrivateFence, which limits them to retained work or the eligible two-operation legacy shape. The remaining before/after marker reads also protect generic public Stage/Abort races: AbortStagedAsync can move any Prepared batch to Aborted while an installer awaits persistence. Lack of a private fence does not make that installer decision immutable. No measured attribution to the open latency failures establishes the claimed budget regression.

findings.claim: Background promoted cleanup failures disappear without an operational signal
findings.evidence: Parent b9 injects a maintenance read failure after real streamed promotion. WaitForPromotedCleanupAsync returns successfully, one durable cleanup page remains, and GetStatusAsync reports neither building nor degraded. The new catch-all emits no event/log/metric; without another foreground phase request retained cleanup can stay invisible. Preserve the bounded cancellation/gate behavior while surfacing failure and retry disposition.

findings.claim: Completed staged retries must report the same historical result as Execute after supersession
findings.evidence: The public staging contract explicitly commits and verifies its durable visible result, and VerifyAsync reads both marker and operation evidence. A newer unexpired writer means that candidate is no longer the current visible result, so operation-unverified is truthful. Both Completed branches are byte-for-byte the same in SDK baseline d4d05; Execute historical receipt semantics do not establish a staging contract violation or a newly introduced failure.

findings.claim: A retained installer exits after Completed receipt reclamation and recreates private scratch
findings.evidence: Individually verified by the parent rerun before grouping: Completed marker is absent, delayed installer persists its original envelope then exits, and exact recovery refuses invalid-recovery-evidence. The physical orphan survives successful cleanup and Abort.

findings.claim: Completed reclamation violates the claimed recoverability of an interrupted stale private write
findings.evidence: Individually verified by the same parent execution before grouping: no retirement proof remains for this Completed retained identity, so the persisted late own envelope cannot be reconciled. The current legacy-only terminal proof does not cover this claim.

notes: All layers returned final reports before triage.
No unchanged same-location/same-claim row qualified for carried disposition.
Probe build mistakes and analyzer warnings are diagnostic history, not acceptance builds. No SDK/consumer source was changed during probes.

groups.root_cause: Own installed expired envelope is accepted as omitted after failed compaction
Completed retained evidence is destroyed before late-installer recovery remains durable
Retained Aborted retirement discards original participant proof
Compensation storage bound is incorrectly equated with original canonical manifest bound
Folders coordinator clock is separately constructed from writer/store deadline clock
Background maintenance silently consumes failures while retaining durable work
Fake ETag probe bypasses its shared visibility resolver
Guide omits deliberately retained fencing metadata lifecycle

loopback: bad_spec has precedence; two direct patch groups survive as explicit requirements; no defer or new approval required
